title: az repos pr work-item list --id ${id} --output json
description: The work items linked to the pull request, which its completion can close, whose number, title, state, assignee, tags, and creation `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` reads in forge/ado:open-prs and forge/ado:pr-closing-issues, with `modules/jq/forge.jq`'s ado_pr, ado_closed, ado_assignees, and ado_tags; every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. The extension reads the links, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/git/pull-request-work-items/list?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1, then every field of each WorkItem, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/work-items/list?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1, as boards-work-item-show.schema.json gives one, and prints [] when the pull request links none.

System.State.description: The process template's state: Closed, Done, and Removed are closed, any other open.

System.AssignedTo.description: An IdentityRef, left out when nobody is assigned; uniqueName is the login az signs in as.

System.Tags.description: The tags, one text joined by "; ", left out when there are none.
